archetypes.name: Sprout
archetypes.blurb: Loves gathering berries and tidying up fallen branches.
archetypes.bestiary: A sleepy little sprout that wakes up at the smell of ripe berries. It loves tidying up fallen leaves and branches.

egg.name: Mossy Egg
egg.desc: Soft and speckled green, it feels warm, as if something inside is dreaming of sun.

juvenile.desc: A flower-crowned sprite that follows the bees and knows where every wild blossom grows. Good at gathering petals and berries.

adult.desc: A gentle garden guardian with a crown of blooms that makes every crop flourish. Helps the garden grow lush and bright.

juvenile.desc: A young creature with bark-plated cheeks and a woodsy smell. Quick with an axe and happy to clear away fallen branches.

adult.desc: A sturdy, leafy friend as tall and steady as an old oak. Chops with patience and helps the timber grow.

archetypes.name: Stone
archetypes.blurb: Loves digging gently through the soil for shiny stones.
archetypes.bestiary: A round, shy mole with pebble-smooth paws. It digs gently for shiny stones and hums happily when it finds one.

egg.name: Pebbly Egg
egg.desc: Heavy and grey with flecks of quartz, it hums softly like a sleepy cave.

juvenile.desc: A little crystal-speckled creature that glints whenever it is happy. Has a knack for spotting gems and a little extra luck.

adult.desc: A grand, glittering creature with a crest of polished gems. Its shine draws rare treasures and good fortune.

juvenile.desc: A round, sturdy little digger that never tires of a good dig. Steady as a hill and strong at mining.

adult.desc: A broad, mossy-backed giant of granite. Mines with great strength and keeps the forge humming along.

archetypes.name: Tide
archetypes.blurb: Loves paddling by the water and fishing for little fish.
archetypes.bestiary: A soft, cool water blob that bubbles happily beside streams. It loves paddling about and fishing for little fish.

egg.name: Ripple Egg
egg.desc: Cool and smooth as river glass, it gurgles gently when you hold it close.

juvenile.desc: A small, pearly blob that loves cool, quiet water. Dives for rare fish and tucked-away treasure maps.

adult.desc: A graceful, coral-crowned creature from the deepest water. Keen-eyed at fishing and forever finding treasure maps.

juvenile.desc: A quick, bubbly stream spirit that dances along the rapids. Fishes swiftly and slips through the water with ease.

adult.desc: A swift, flowing creature with a long, shimmering tail. Carries the river's gift to the fishing spots and never tires.

archetypes.name: Wild
archetypes.blurb: Loves quietly tracking small game through the tall grass.
archetypes.bestiary: A tawny little hunter-cat with twitchy ears and soft freckles. It quietly tracks small game through the tall grass.

egg.name: Tawny Egg
egg.desc: Warm tawny shell with soft freckles, and a faint rustle comes from within.

juvenile.desc: A sleek, keen-eyed young cat with soft sable paws. Tracks small game quietly and brings home a gentle catch.

adult.desc: A graceful lynx who hunts at dusk with a careful, kind heart. Quick on the trail and often brings back extra hides.

juvenile.desc: A curious young explorer with a sharp nose and bright ears. Follows faint tracks and sniffs out hidden spots.

adult.desc: A clever fox with a keen nose for paths and buried things. Digs up treasure and finds the way through any trail.

mythics.desc: An ancient guardian of the Heartgrove, older than its oldest tree. Those who tend the grove say they can hear it humming in the leaves.
A slow, gentle giant of crystal and moss that sleeps beneath the grove's roots. Some say it only wakes when the Heartgrove is truly at peace.
A calm river spirit that drifts through the still pools of the Heartgrove. Its song is said to carry lost things back home.
A silent, silver-furred guardian that watches over the grove at dusk. Few have seen it, but its paw prints appear in the morning dew.

lines.hatch: The shell cracks and a sleepy little face peeks out!
ate: {name} licks the last crumbs of the {food}.
evolved: Warm light wraps around {name} as they become a {species}.
{name} stretches tall and blinks in surprise. They are a {species} now!
What a big day! {name} has grown into a {species}.
{name} gives a happy little cheer. Hello, {species}!
gift: {name} drops a {item} at your feet with a happy bounce.
{name} found a {item} and wanted you to have it.
{name} tucks a {item} into your hands with a shy smile.
Look! {name} has brought you a {item} from their wanderings.
favorite: One bite of the {food} and {name} melts with joy. Their favorite!
{name} hums happily over the {food}. Now you know their favorite.
{name} will remember the {food} forever. It's their favorite dish.
